tools.name: check_recall
tools.description: Checks U.S. government recall records and returns the status with the agency's own links and a signed receipt. Give `product` (a name, matched against CPSC recall titles) or `vehicle` (model year, make, model, looked up at NHTSA). Returns status recalls_found with the newest recalls (id, title, date

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Fetch a receipt issued by check_recall (format v1, signed, software-only TRACE record). The same document is served at https://recalls.bot2botlabs.com/receipts/{receipt_id}.
